title: Operation Turning Point
description: Secure the transport network from the railhead to the harbor. Ten medium-difficulty operations across eight theaters, all on 40 × 40 maps.

missions.title: Broken Arrow
missions.objective: Extract the trapped railway workers before the hostile patrol reaches them.

missions.title: Blacktop
missions.objective: Clear the road junction and reopen the supply route.

missions.title: Cold Storage
missions.objective: Seize the enemy command marker inside the industrial zone.

missions.title: Harvest Moon
missions.objective: Protect and evacuate civilians crossing the occupied farmland.

missions.title: Terminal Velocity
missions.objective: Hold the forward communications post until relief arrives.

missions.title: Green Line
missions.objective: Destroy the hostile force concealed along the woodland approach.

missions.title: Glass House
missions.objective: Breach the urban command sector and capture its operations flag.

missions.title: Harbor Watch
missions.objective: Hold the port communications flag until the waterfront is secure.

missions.title: Open Skies
missions.objective: Rescue the airfield ground crews under sustained attack.

missions.title: Turn for Turn
missions.objective: Defeat the remaining hostile command force and end the campaign.
